summary: Iteration 53 — verified the new two-stage recruitment offer end to end. Backend pytest suite (12/12 passed): all three Stripe checkout sessions verified via stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve (DIY 29700 / success /purchase/success / cancel /offer/recruitment?checkout=cancelled / metadata recruitment_campaign_diy_297; DWY 149700 / success /board-recruitment-intake / metadata direct_board_recruitment_project; Selection 29700 / cancel /app/recruitment/selection-offer?checkout=cancelled / metadata recruitment_selection_onboarding_297 with a DISTINCT price whose lookup_key is recruitment_selection_onboarding_297, confirmed different price id from the DIY 297 price). Unpaid real selection session cannot be claimed (register -> 402). Intake simulation: DIY paid txn -> context eligible + submit redirect /recruitment-start-here; DWY paid txn -> submit redirect Calendly; bogus session -> 404/402. Course gating for a stage-1-only member: exactly modules 2,3,4,5,6 at positions 1-5, locked flags {2:F,3:F,4:T,5:T,6:T}, progress on 2/3 = 200, module 4 = 403, /api/workspace/applications 403, /api/workspace/profile 200, /api/workspace/generate general_interview_invitation 403; after adding recruitment_selection_onboarding all modules unlock, applications 200, module-4 progress 200. Frontend E2E (Playwright): /recruit approved copy + single-step form submit redirects to /offer/recruitment; /offer/recruitment buttons read exactly 'Launch It Yourself — $297' and 'Do It With Us — $1,497', guarantee + testimonial carousel + video present, DIY click reaches Stripe US$297.00 checkout; intake blocked card shown without session_id and with bogus session, both links -> /offer/recruitment with correct $297/$1,497 labels; no $497/$2,497/$5,497 anywhere on /offer/recruitment or the intake blocked card (iter52 stale-pricing defect is fixed); member with both entitlements sees 5 STEP-labelled cards with real titles, '0 of 5 steps finished', no 'Module N', module/2 shows 'STEP 1 OF 5' + correct title, Previous Step disabled, NEXT STEP -> module/3, /app/recruitment/selection-offer redirects to module/4; stage-1-only member sees module-locked-4/5/6 linking to /app/recruitment/selection-offer, module/4 redirects to the selection offer, module 3 NEXT STEP -> selection offer, offer page shows headline 'Ready to Start Selection & Interviews?', $297 One Time, YouTube embed, and the buy button creates a real Stripe checkout; /recruitment-start-here shows 5 instruction blocks and CTA -> /app/recruitment/self-guided/module/2. No reactivation/activation funnel was touched.

ui_bugs.issue: Unknown authenticated routes render a completely blank page instead of a 404/redirect (reproduced with /app/recruitment/does-not-exist and /app/recruitment/workspace — body length 0). Any bad internal link will look like a broken app.

Copy says 'watch the video and choose how you would like to launch your board recruitment' but the blocked card contains no video embed — only the two links. Either add the video or drop the 'watch the video' phrase.

issues: Locked cards replace the 'STEP 3/4/5' eyebrow with 'SELECTION, INTERVIEW & ONBOARDING PACKAGE', so the 5-step numbering visually breaks (steps read 1, 2, then three unnumbered cards). Consider 'STEP 3 · LOCKED — SELECTION PACKAGE' to keep the sequence readable.

Optional: align the intake blocked-card copy with the absence of a video embed.
